blocks.content:
Article 148
Guardian of Public Purse
Tenure – 6 years / 65 years
Removal – Like Supreme Court Judge
Audits Union & State Accounts
Reports examined by PAC

items: Article 148 is frequently tested as the constitutional basis for the authority auditing Union & State accounts.
Tenure details (6 years / 65 years) are a very common objective question topic in RRB and other competitive exams.
Notice the removal process: it is strictly 'Like Supreme Court Judge'.
Always remember that audit reports are examined by the Public Accounts Committee (PAC).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 148 establishes the constitutional authority known as the Guardian of Public Purse.
Tenure is specified as 6 years or up to 65 years of age, whichever comes earlier.
Removal from office follows the same process as that of a Supreme Court Judge.
Audits the accounts of both the Union and the State governments.
The official audit reports are examined by the Public Accounts Committee (PAC).
